messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for CirrusPay — seeing a sustained jump in error rate yesterday evening (~4.3%). Quick breakdown: 502s on /v1/generate, timeouts on /v1/chat/stream, 429s on /v1/embed/bulk. Sharing initial numbers and next steps.

tanvi_success: thanks — can you post the top endpoints + raw counts?

maria_cs: Pasting quick snapshot: 
```
/v1/generate          1245 failures (502)
/v1/chat/stream       436 failures (timeout)
/v1/embed/bulk        198 failures (429)
/v1/retrieval/query   32 failures (504)
```

alex_sre: I see matching 502 spikes from the NLB/nginx layer — connection resets and upstream 502s. Looks like upstream timeouts triggering. I'll increase upstream timeouts to 90s and roll a config patch. @jordan_support FYI for customer comms.

jordan_support: noted. i'll draft a short customer note: what happened, what we did, and immediate mitigations (client retries + backoff). Their renewal is in ~6 weeks, do we want to flag as renewal risk?

maria_cs: flag as potential renewal risk if not normalized in 2 weeks. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for heavy /v1/generate traffic to cut load.

tanvi_success: CirrusPay is hitting embed bulk at peaks ~350 rps — can we temporarily bump their rate limit for /v1/embed/bulk?

alex_sre: I can do a controlled lift for 48h with guards. Opening now. Also adding a dashboard panel for 502 rate by URI.

deploy-bot: Rate Limit Lift applied | customer=cirruspay | routes=[/v1/embed/bulk] | expires=2024-05-03T04:12:00Z

maria_cs: Action items:
- alex_sre: increase upstream timeout to 90s + monitor (in progress)
- alex_sre: dashboard panel for 502s/top URIs
- tanvi_success: validate embed rate lift and watch 24h
- jordan_support: draft customer note + include enablement links

tanvi_success: ack — will monitor and report daily.

jordan_support: draft sent to maria_cs for review. will send once approved.

maria_cs: quick status update: error rate down to ~1.1% after timeout bump + rate lift, still watching. Marking this check-in as resolved for now unless it regresses. :thumbsup:

alex_sre: logs confirm 502s dropped to near-zero. Putting alert into watch mode for 48h.

jordan_support: sent a concise note to CirrusPay with mitigation steps and best-practice enablement links; customer requested a short enablement call next week.

maria_cs: scheduled 30-min enablement call with CirrusPay Thu 14:00 PT — agenda: retry/backoff, caching, and rate-limit tuning. thanks team for the quick turnaround.
